pages.text: $(bold)Life Curse$() is an unlevelled trait innate to Hydra Fang arrowhead material: +2 projectile power; on hit, inflicts Poison I for 10 seconds and heals the attacker for the actual damage dealt. Arrows with this trait are crafted in double quantity, stacking with conservation.$(br2)$(italic)Hydra blood is never spilled in vain.$()
